question: Should Crabbox reserve `CRABBOX_LEASE_ID`, `CRABBOX_RUN_ID`, and `CRABBOX_SLUG` immediately even when existing jobs already forward those names, or should reservation use a compatibility transition?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes user-controlled remote environment values, and source evidence cannot determine whether that breaking upgrade behavior is an acceptable product contract.

options.title: Use a compatibility transition
options.body: Preserve existing forwarded values by default and add an explicit, documented migration or opt-in before enforcing Crabbox-owned values.

options.title: Approve immediate reservation
options.body: Accept that upgrades overwrite forwarded values for these three names and document the breaking contract prominently.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the current environment contract unchanged until maintainers choose a durable metadata namespace policy.

recommendation.title: Use a compatibility transition
recommendation.body: Preserve existing forwarded values by default and add an explicit, documented migration or opt-in before enforcing Crabbox-owned values.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest available implementation context for explaining the tradeoffs, while final acceptance still requires maintainer sponsorship.
